mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, the 20-day forward return is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS decreases from prior month, the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and stagnant monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 5.0%) signal stagflation risk, which triggers equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.0, the 60-day forward return is positive, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing contraction, which precedes equity market downturns and negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when INDPRO < 100, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) reflect strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between RSAFS and 5-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases > 0.2pp from prior month, the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and Fed rate cuts (FEDFUNDS decreases) signal an active policy response to economic weakness, which drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS decreases from prior month
evidence_refs: doc:Monetary Policy Response to Economic Slowdown
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS decreases, the 20-day forward return is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing booms (HOUST > 1600), a decline in housing starts (HOUST decreases from prior month) signals a cooling housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In the housing boom regime, when HOUST decreases from prior month, the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.
